How many online stores have an llms.txt file in 2026?

In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 216 of 1,305 stores we could check publish an llms.txt file (16.6%). Left out of the share: 1,549 stores we couldn't check. 1,117 of them were refused, and a refusal is not "no". A published file or profile is a declaration, not proof that agents can buy. ShopBot Index does not test purchases.

Big retailers first (46): 7-Eleven, Aldi, Allegro, American Eagle Outfitters, Asprey, aussieBum, AutoZone, Berlitz Corporation, Boozt, Canadian Tire, Chow Tai Fook, CVS Health, Denner, Dillard's, dm-drogerie markt, Etsy, FAO Schwarz, Farfetch, Fiverr, Flying Tiger Copenhagen, Fruit of the Loom, Globus, Groupon, Halfords, Hostinger, Kaufland, Lojas Renner, MediaMarkt, Mexx, Morrisons, On AG, Poundland, REWE Group, Saturn, Seven & I Holdings Co., Shein, Shopify, Target Corporation, The Body Shop, Trendyol, Upwork, Verizon, Vipshop, Wix.com, Zalando and Zellers.

How we check

We request /llms.txt. It counts as published only on HTTP 200 when the body starts with # and the start of the body is not an HTML page (llms.txt). On Shopify this file is generated by the platform. A store is one we could check when at least one website returned that file or a not-found response. Refusals, errors and checks we did not reach are left out. A store counts when at least one of its websites meets the rule. This page counts stores. The Beyond UCP table counts websites, so the two numbers can differ. How we check.
